items.source: Annotation to configure the JPA 2.1 EntityGraphs that should be used on repository methods. Since 1.9 we support the definition of dynamic EntityGraphs by allowing to customize the fetch-graph via attributePaths() ad-hoc fetch-graph configuration. If attributePaths() are specified then we ignore the entity-graph name value() and treat this EntityGraph as dynamic.
items.translation: 注解用于配置应在仓库方法中使用的 JPA 2.1 EntityGraph。 自 1.9 版本起，我们支持通过 attributePaths() 进行临时 fetch-graph 配置，从而定义动态的 EntityGraph。 如果指定了 attributePaths()，我们将忽略实体图名称 value()，并将此 EntityGraph 视为动态处理。

items.source: The paths of attributes of this EntityGraph to use, empty by default. You can refer to direct properties of the entity or nested properties via a property.nestedProperty.
items.translation: 此EntityGraph的属性路径默认为空。您可以通过property.nestedProperty引用实体的直接属性或嵌套属性。

items.source: The paths of attributes of this EntityGraph to use, empty by default.
items.translation: 此EntityGraph的属性路径默认为空。

items.source: The name of the EntityGraph to use. If empty we fall-back to JpaQueryMethod.getNamedQueryName() as the value.
items.translation: 要使用的实体图名称。如果为空，则回退到JpaQueryMethod.getNamedQueryName()作为值。
